description: This Java class 'OverlayWindowBuilder' constructs and manages overlay windows in an Android environment, allowing configuration of size, position, background color, and touch interactions, and responsible for adding the overlay to the window manager.

classes.name: OverlayWindowBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to create and display customizable overlay windows with specified size, position, background color, and touch handling in Android.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of OverlayWindowBuilder with a specified content view.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the width and height of the overlay window.

methods.name: setGravity
methods.description: Sets the gravity (alignment) of the overlay window.

methods.name: setRelativePosition
methods.description: Sets the relative X and Y position of the overlay window.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the overlay window.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Builds and adds the overlay window to the window manager, making it visible on screen, with touch dragging support.
